candidates.background: Peter Rusek is a Waco attorney and shareholder at Sheehy, Lovelace and Mayfield, P.C. Governor Greg Abbott appointed him on September 22, 2025, to replace Judge Gary Coley Jr., who resigned in February 2025; he was sworn in on December 1, 2025. He holds a B.S. in psychology from Texas A&M University and a J.D. from Baylor Law School, where KWTX reports he has been an adjunct professor since 1987. He served on the Midway ISD board from 1996, most recently as president, and has represented local entities including the Waco school board, McLennan Community College, and the Brazos River Authority.

record.text: Appointed by Governor Greg Abbott in September 2025 to the 74th District Court for a term ending December 31, 2026, or until a successor is elected and qualified.

notes.text: Unopposed on the November 3, 2026 ballot. He is seeking the remainder of the unexpired term.

candidates.current_role: Justice of the Peace, Precinct 1, Place 1, McLennan County, since 2015
candidates.background: Dianne L. Hensley was first elected justice of the peace in McLennan County in 2014 and has been re-elected since, according to the Supreme Court of Texas. She won the 2026 Republican primary with 56.71 percent in a four-candidate field.

record.text: In November 2019 the State Commission on Judicial Conduct issued her a public warning, finding that her practice of declining to officiate same-sex weddings for religious reasons while referring couples elsewhere violated Canon 4A(1); she did not appeal and instead sued the commission in December 2019.
In June 2024 the Supreme Court of Texas held that, apart from one declaratory request, her lawsuit was not barred and remanded it to the court of appeals.

notes.text: Won the 2026 Republican primary with 56.71 percent over Sterling Shepperd, Adriana Bost and Anthony Luevanos.
